title: Balanced Search and Indexing for a Hierarchical Software Job Title Tree in PHP
topic: A Family Tree of Software Job Titles
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a PHP implementation of a balanced search tree that models a hierarchical family of software job titles. The data structure supports insertion, lookup, and ancestor retrieval while preserving a strict height-balanced invariant and key-ordered property. Formal analysis shows that point and range queries execute in $O(\log N)$ time, and insertions maintain balance in $O(\log N)$ time. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a source-level complexity of 187 SLOC and 20 function blocks. The implementation is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261114_210235_a_family_tree_of_software_job}. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261114_210235_a_family_tree_of_software_job}
